title: RimWorld Pawn Skill Taxonomy (relocated + adapted)
description: Relocated from C:\Users\joshu\Projects\zomboid\GlueActors\Contents\mods\GlueActors\media\data\seeds\colony\pawn-skill-taxonomy.json (Phase A2 convention). This is the one colony/pawn-* file the Zomboid Z-1 lane (glue monorepo commit f40f3d710) did NOT relocate into schemas/seeds/actors -- Z-1 relocated pawn-need-taxonomy, pawn-schedule-templates, and pawn-work-priorities but left pawn-skill-taxonomy behind (it authors no skill-gated candidate in the zomboid-day-tick set, so it wasn't needed for Z-1's scope). Verified verbatim against the real installed RimWorld 1.6.4871 Data/Core/Defs/SkillDefs/Skills.xml on this machine: all 12 keys, gainSources, and gatesWork entries match RimWorld's real SkillDef list exactly (only the JSON 'key' field is adapted here, from the source file's lowercase skillLabel-style key to the real RimWorld SkillDef.defName so this file can be looked up directly against Pawn.skills.GetSkill(SkillDefOf.X)). This file lives in GlueRimworld's own Seeds/ (not glue's schemas/seeds/actors/) because nothing in the shared engine consumes it yet -- it exists so a follow-on RimWorld-specific behavior-candidate seed (skill-gated work verbs, mirroring zomboid-day-labor.json's shape) has real data to skill-gate against, matching colony/pawn-work-priorities.json's skillGate fields already landed in glue.
